title: Inspection following an adjustment or repair.
officialText:
Following a repair or adjustment at a site, the sidewalk shed
shall be inspected by a qualified person designated by the designer, the permit holder for the shed, or a third party acceptable
to both the designer and the permit holder to verify the adequacy of the repair or adjustment. The results of the inspection
shall be recorded, signed, and dated by the person who performed the inspection.
